articles.title: You Won’t Believe How Long the Oldest Cat in History Lived—And the Longevity Tricks His Owner Swore By
articles.content:
如果你是宠物主人，你一定会明白这种感受：猫的寿命似乎总是不够长。如果它们能陪伴我们更久，那该多好啊！

得克萨斯州一名叫Jake Perry的男子似乎发现了猫类长寿的秘诀。他为自己的猫设计了一种特殊的饮食，并运用了一些独特的方法（我们稍后会详细介绍），使得他养的两只猫都活到了30岁以上。通常，家猫的寿命大约在13到17年之间，虽然有些猫通过良好的营养可以活到20岁以上。

但超过30岁？这几乎闻所未闻。更令人难以置信的是，Perry的两只猫都登上了吉尼斯世界纪录。

目前吉尼斯世界纪录中最长寿的猫名叫Creme Puff，它是一只混血斑点猫，出生于1967年8月3日，直到2005年8月6日才去世，这意味着Creme Puff去世时已经活了38年又3天。

关于这个记录有些争议，因为威尔士有一只名叫Lucky的猫据称活到了39岁。然而，由于缺乏该猫的年龄证明，吉尼斯还是认可Creme Puff的记录。Perry是一名水管工，他不仅拥有Creme Puff，还曾拥有之前的记录保持者Granpa Rexs Allen，后者活到了34岁。

在2015年，Atlas Obscura前往Perry的住所，探究他的猫为什么能活这么长寿。当时85岁的Perry将猫的长寿归功于三个主要因素：

1. **特殊饮食**：Perry为他的猫准备了一种独特的饮食，包括牛肉、鸡蛋、咖啡豆、各种蔬菜和水果，甚至还有一些意想不到的成分，比如威士忌和大麻。他相信这些食物能够提供猫所需的营养。
2. **充足的活动**：尽管年龄很大，Perry的猫仍然保持着活跃的生活方式。他认为运动对猫的健康至关重要。
3. **充满爱心的照顾**：Perry认为，除了物质上的照顾，猫也需要足够的关爱和陪伴。他花费大量时间与猫互动，确保它们在心理上也感到幸福。

虽然我们不能保证你的猫能像Creme Puff和Granpa一样长寿（我们也不建议你模仿他们的饮食！），但我们确实支持你用爱心去照顾你的猫咪伴侣。

（本文首发于《Reader's Digest》）
articles.summary:
If you’re a pet owner, you probably know how it feels: Cats don’t live long enough. Wouldn’t it be great if they stayed at our side longer?

Well, a man in Texas named Jake Perry appears to have discovered the secret to cat longevity. He came up with a special diet for his cats, along with some other quirky tricks we’ll get to in a minute, and two of them lived to be more than 30 years old. Most domestic cats only live to about 13 to 17 years of age, although some can live past 20 with good nutrition.

But over 30? It’s almost unheard of. And incredibly, not just one but two of Perry’s cats landed in the Guinness World Records.

The oldest cat in the world was named Creme Puff

The cat currently holding the Guinness age record was named Creme Puff. She was a mixed tabby born on Aug. 3, 1967, and she lived until Aug. 6, 2005, which made Creme Puff 38 years and three days old when she died.

There is some dispute over this title, as there was a Welsh cat named Lucky who supposedly lived to age 39. However, that cat’s age lacks documentation, so Guinness honors Creme Puff. Perry, a plumber, owned Creme Puff as well as the previous record holder, a cat named Granpa Rexs Allen, who lived to be 34.

Why did Perry’s cats live so long?

Looking for the secret to cat longevity, Atlas Obscura went to Perry’s home back in 2015 to find out why his cats enjoyed such long lives. Then 85, he attributed it to three main things:

  • Diet: Perry fed his cats dry cat food, which he supplemented with eggs, turkey bacon and broccoli. He also, controversially, fed them small amounts of red wine and coffee with cream. He believed the wine would “circulate the arteries,” but the American College of Veterinary Pharmacists says caffeine can be toxic to cats and should be avoided. (Dairy products are also not recommended.)
  • Habitat: Perry kept his cats in a garage where he constantly played nature documentaries for them. He even built them their own home theater with real seats!
  • Love: Perry believed that his cats lived so long because he showered them with loving affection, remembering every single one of their birthdays.

We’re not saying that your cats will live as long as Creme Puff and Granpa (and we’re not endorsing their diets!), but we can definitely get behind showering your feline companions with love.

articles.title: The Wait Is Almost Over! Here’s When Pumpkin Spice Season Officially Arrives at Starbucks
articles.content:
别再看日历了——真正告诉我们秋天即将来临的，只有星巴克宣布南瓜香料拿铁回归的消息。自2003年首次亮相以来，标志性的PSL（Pumpkin Spice Latte）不仅仅是一杯咖啡，更成为了季节性事件，开启了南瓜风潮和温暖毛衣氛围，粉丝们甚至会为第一口季节初体验倒计时。

现在，倒计时正式开始。星巴克已经宣布南瓜香料拿铁及其他热门秋季饮品将在本月回归。我们暂时不会透露具体日期（这样才有趣嘛！），但可以确定的是，你的南瓜渴望不会再等太久了。

继续阅读，了解PSL具体回归时间、菜单上还有哪些秋季饮品，以及其他咖啡连锁店如何加入秋季南瓜风潮。

《读者文摘》的《阅读升级》新闻通讯将为您提供更多食品新闻、趣味事实、幽默、清洁、旅行和科技资讯。

简单的答案是：星巴克决定的。对于数百万咖啡爱好者（包括我！）来说，秋天不是从树叶变色或天气变凉时候开始的。而是从星巴克宣布南瓜香料拿铁回归的那一刻开始。

2003年，PSL首次亮相，由星巴克饮料开发员彼得·杜克斯（Peter Dukes）及其团队在公司位于西雅图的秘密“液体实验室”内创造。趣闻：它最初以另一个名字——秋季收获拿铁——进行测试，最终才定名为南瓜香料拿铁。该饮品于2003年10月10日在仅100家店铺首发，从此开启了南瓜风潮。

时至今日，星巴克已经在全球售出超过4.24亿杯PSL。这杯小拿铁还催生了南瓜冷萃、奶茶等饮品，以及各种面包甜品，其中一些甚至比你想象的更早亮相。这不是你的错觉：星巴克近年来一直提前推出PSL，从9月提前到8月底，推动了不官方的“南瓜季”竞赛。

星巴克正式确认，2026年秋季菜单，包括备受喜爱的南瓜香料拿铁，将于8月25日星期二回归。

南瓜香料拿铁或许是主角，但绝非唯一回归的秋季热门。星巴克将于8月25日推出整个南瓜主题饮品系列，外加一款备受喜爱的核桃口味。以下是你可以期待的：

articles.summary:
Forget the calendar—there’s only one announcement that truly tells us fall is right around the corner: Starbucks revealing when its pumpkin spice latte is coming back. Since making its debut in 2003, the iconic PSL has become more than just a coffee order. It’s a full-blown seasonal event, kicking off pumpkin everything and cozy sweater vibes, and fans literally count down the minutes to the season’s first sip.

Well, the countdown is officially on. Starbucks has announced when the pumpkin spice latte—and the rest of its fan-favorite fall lineup—will return this month. We’re not revealing the date just yet (where’s the fun in that?), but let’s just say your pumpkin cravings won’t have to wait much longer.

Keep reading to find out exactly when the PSL returns, what additional fall drinks will be on the menu and which other coffee chains are joining the pumpkin party this fall.

Get Reader’s Digest’s Read Up newsletter for more food news, fun facts, humor, cleaning, travel and tech all week long.

What signifies the start of PSL season?

The short answer? Starbucks says so. For millions of coffee lovers (including me!), fall doesn’t officially begin when the leaves start changing or the weather finally cools off. It begins the second Starbucks announces the pumpkin spice latte is back.

PSL burst onto the scene in 2003, when Starbucks beverage developer Peter Dukes and his team created the now-iconic drink inside the company’s secretive Seattle “Liquid Lab.” Fun fact: It was tested under a different name—fall harvest latte—before the pumpkin spice latte won out. The drink debuted on Oct. 10, 2003, in just 100 stores, and the rest is pumpkin-spiced history.

Fast-forward to today, and Starbucks has sold more than 424 million PSLs worldwide since the drink’s inception. That little latte has also inspired pumpkin cold brews, chai drinks, bakery treats and more—some of it appearing way earlier in the season than you might think. And it’s not your imagination: Starbucks has steadily moved the release earlier over the years, from September to late August, fueling the unofficial “pumpkin season” race.

So when does PSL season officially start?

Starbucks officially confirmed that its 2026 fall menu, including the beloved pumpkin spice latte, returns on Tuesday, Aug. 25.

What else will be on the fall Starbucks menu?

The pumpkin spice latte may be the star of the show, but it’s far from the only fall favorite making a comeback. Starbucks is serving up an entire lineup of pumpkin-packed drinks—plus one beloved pecan pick—when the seasonal menu returns on Aug. 25. Here’s what to expect:

  • Iced pumpkin cream shaken espresso (new): This fresh twist on the classic shaken espresso has a cozy pumpkin flavor.
  • Pumpkin spice chai (new): Pumpkin spice meets chai for what could be this year’s breakout fall drink.
  • Iced pumpkin cream matcha (new): Matcha lovers can finally get in on the pumpkin craze.
  • Pumpkin cream cold brew (returning): This fan-favorite cold coffee is topped with silky pumpkin cream cold foam.
  • Iced pumpkin cream chai (returning): This fall staple that combines spiced chai with pumpkin cream cold foam.
  • Pumpkin spice frappuccino (returning): Consider this the blended version of the iconic PSL for those who like their pumpkin icy.
  • Pecan crunch oatmilk latte (returning): Not feeling pumpkin? This nutty seasonal favorite is also back for another year.

Who else is getting into the PSL spirit, and when?

Of course, Starbucks isn’t the only chain preparing for PSL season. Here’s what to expect from other popular coffeehouses this fall.

  • Dunkin’: Dunkin’s fall menu returns on Aug. 19, bringing back its signature pumpkin spice latte, pumpkin-flavored coffee and more.
  • Peet’s Coffee: The chain usually launches its fall menu in late August, often with pumpkin lattes, pumpkin cold brews and pumpkin bakery treats.
  • Dutch Bros: Dutch Bros typically rolls out its fall lineup in late August. You’ll want to try the caramel pumpkin brûlée breve.
  • Caribou Coffee: This coffeehouse is known for its pumpkin latte, pumpkin white mocha and pumpkin baked goods that typically arrive in late August.
  • 7 Brew: While the menu varies by location, its seasonal pumpkin drinks generally arrive in late August or early September.
